USDROP - CUSTOMER SERVICE RESPONSE TEMPLATES
Fast, friendly macros for common tickets. Replace {{placeholders}}.
================================================================

----- WHERE IS MY ORDER (WISMO) -----
Hi {{first_name}}, thanks for reaching out! Your order #{{order_number}} is on its way.
Tracking: {{tracking_link}} - estimated delivery {{delivery_estimate}}.
Let me know if you need anything else!

----- SHIPPING DELAY -----
Hi {{first_name}}, apologies for the wait. Your order is in transit but running a little behind due to {{reason}}.
Here's your tracking: {{tracking_link}}. As a thank-you for your patience, here's 10% off your next order: SORRY10.

----- DAMAGED / DEFECTIVE ITEM -----
Hi {{first_name}}, so sorry your item arrived damaged! No need to return it.
We're shipping a free replacement today / issuing a full refund (your choice). Which would you prefer?

----- REFUND REQUEST -----
Hi {{first_name}}, happy to help. I've started your refund of {{amount}} to your original payment method - it usually appears within 5-7 business days.
Is there anything we could have done better?

----- CANCELLATION (before shipping) -----
Hi {{first_name}}, your order #{{order_number}} hasn't shipped yet, so I've cancelled it and refunded {{amount}}. You'll see it within 5-7 business days.

----- CHARGEBACK PREVENTION -----
Hi {{first_name}}, I see you may have opened a dispute. We'd love to sort this out directly and faster - I can refund or replace right now. Just reply here and we'll take care of it today.
